"""Multi-line behaviour and further boundary probes."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"


def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp/dev")
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:2000])
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    if out:
        assert out.endswith("\n")
    return [json.loads(l) for l in out.splitlines()], out


fails = 0


def check(name, payload, expected):
    global fails
    got, raw = run(payload)
    if got != expected:
        print("FAIL %s\n  got    %s\n  expect %s" % (name, json.dumps(got)[:300], json.dumps(expected)[:300]))
        fails += 1


ok_req = {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": []}
ok_out = {"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[0]], "distance": [None]}, "queries": []}

# interleaved errors and successes, no trailing newline
check("mixed lines no trailing newline",
      b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\nbad\n\n{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}',
      [ok_out, {"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}, {"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}, ok_out])

# CRLF line endings
check("crlf", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r\n{"services":["b"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r\n',
      [ok_out, {"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[0]], "distance": [None]}, "queries": []}])

# CR-only line: content includes the CR (invalid json)
check("cr only", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r', None)
got, _ = run(b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r')
assert got == [ok_out], got

# lone CR line
check("lone cr", b"\r", [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# BOM
check("bom", b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + json.dumps(ok_req).encode(), [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# valid multibyte utf-8 service names
req = {"services": ["α", "ω", "日本", "😀"], "rules": [
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["日本", "😀"]}}], "queries": [["α", "日本", "😀"]]}
check("multibyte", (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode(), None)
got, _ = run((json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode())
assert got[0]["ok"] is True and got[0]["queries"][0]["allow"] is True, got

# 4-byte utf-8 in query
req2 = {"services": ["😀"], "rules": [], "queries": [["😀"] * 10]}
got, _ = run((json.dumps(req2) + "\n").encode())
assert got == [{"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[0]], "distance": [None]},
                "queries": [{"state": 0, "allow": False, "distance": None}]}], got

# numbers where strings belong
check("number service", b'{"services":[1e999],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])
check("float in path", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":[1.5]}}],"queries":[]}',
      [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])
check("1e999 in queries", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[[1e999]]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])
check("negative zero", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[-0]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])
check("exp number", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[[1e2]]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])

# unmatched but balanced-depth delimiters (depth scan tolerates, json parse fails)
check("mismatched delimiters", b'{["services":[]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])
check("only openers depth 64", b"[" * 64, [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])
check("only openers depth 65", b"[" * 65, [{"ok": False, "error": "E_LIMIT"}])
check("closers then openers", b"}]]" + b"[" * 64, [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# string with escaped quote and brackets
req3 = {"services": ['a"b[{}]', "[x]"], "rules": [
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": ['a"b[{}]']}}], "queries": [['a"b[{}]', "[x]"]]}
got, _ = run((json.dumps(req3) + "\n").encode())
assert got[0]["ok"] is True, got
assert got[0]["dfa"]["next"] and len(got[0]["dfa"]["next"][0]) == 2, got

# backslash at end of line (unterminated string)
check("trailing backslash", b'{"services":["ab\\', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# tab/newline escaped inside service token
req4 = {"services": ["a\tb\nc"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a\tb\nc"]]}
got, _ = run((json.dumps(req4) + "\n").encode())
assert got == [ok_out], got

# raw tab inside string is invalid json
check("raw tab in string", b'{"services":["a\tb"]}', [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# duplicate keys inside expression
check("dup in when", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true","op":"false"}}],"queries":[]}',
      [{"ok": False, "error": "E_JSON"}])

# keys in unusual order / extra whitespace
got, _ = run(b'{ "queries" : [ ] , "rules" : [ ] , "services" : [ "z" ] }\n')
assert got == [{"ok": True, "dfa": {"start": 0, "accept": [False], "next": [[0]], "distance": [None]}, "queries": []}], got

# 8 lines maximum, all fine
payload = b"".join((json.dumps(ok_req) + "\n").encode() for _ in range(8))
got, _ = run(payload)
assert len(got) == 8 and all(g["ok"] for g in got)

# very long single token service (64 chars) with punctuation
svc = "".join(chr(c) for c in range(33, 97))[:64]
req5 = {"services": [svc], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": [svc]}}], "queries": [[svc]]}
got, _ = run((json.dumps(req5) + "\n").encode())
assert got[0]["ok"] and got[0]["queries"][0]["allow"] is True, got

# atom path tokens must be known; unicode escapes
check("escaped token mismatch", b'{"services":["\\u0061"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["a"]}}],"queries":[]}',
      [{"ok": False, "error": "E_SCHEMA"}])
got, _ = run(b'{"services":["\\u0061"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\\u0061"]}}],"queries":[["a"]]}\n')
assert got[0]["ok"] and got[0]["queries"][0]["allow"] is True, got

print("failures:", fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
